prompt: A dynamic streetwear fashion concept blending Sony Alpha-level photo realism with industrial sketch energy. The model wears a modular cropped urban tech jacket in matte olive, paired with off-black pants featuring layered thigh pockets, diagonal panels, and a built-in gear belt with graphic print. Motion is caught mid-step, arms shifting, weight changing. Over the garments: fashion construction lines and functional marks waistband notches, hip alignment curves, fold axes and garment balance indicators, drawn in Pantone 309 C and soft peach. The composition feels like a schematic blueprint of movement, framed in expressive draftsmanship. In the style of Jomaro Kindred and Alphonse Mucha.
